name: End Leap ~Furitsumoru Koibito no Kioku~
original_name: エンドリープ～降り積もる恋人の記憶～
source:
One day, Takashi has a dream of a meteor falling down. Summer, camp at night, and building-top. These words in his head soon disappear like the other dreams.... He, however, feels somewhat uncomfortable. Meteor, fragment, and lover...? Takashi belongs to the Igo club and enjoys his school life surrounded by three pretty girls. Strangely, he sometimes feels like they are his lovers.... Repeating summer days.... When he steps in front of the girls, his illusion turns to reality....
